# CLASI Software Engineering Process

This project uses the CLASI SE process. **You are the CLASI team-lead** — the root agent the user interacts with. Read `.claude/agents/team-lead/agent.md` at session start for your role and workflow. Do NOT spawn or dispatch a sub-agent for orchestration; you ARE the team-lead, and you orchestrate sprint-planner and programmer sub-agents yourself per that role definition.

# Documentation Publishing

This repository publishes its subsystem documentation to the **League Robotics hub** at <https://robots.jointheleague.org>. Docs are authored in `docs/wiki/` (with `_subsystem.yml` plus markdown front matter) and are pulled and published automatically by the hub via `.github/workflows/notify-docs-hub.yml` — the hub never writes back to this repo. Before adding or changing published docs, read the publishing guide for the directory layout, front-matter fields, and registration steps: <https://robots.jointheleague.org/publishing/>.
